summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting on June 16, 2026, for shareholder vote on its business combination with Teamshares Inc. The definitive proxy was filed with the SEC alongside an effective S-4 registration statement; record date is May 7, 2026. Combined entity will be listed on Nasdaq. Shareholders are directed to vote via virtual meeting or in-person; Sodali & Co serves as proxy solicitor. To watch: shareholder approval and redemptions will dictate deal-closing mechanics; risk-arb spread will reflect uncertainty around redemption levels.
